description: This visual developed in partnership with Hamed Behairy - CFA.... one of top financial trainers in the world Decomposition Tree Visual is a very useful tool for exploratory data analysis. It allows you to break down a measure or metric into its contributing factors, helping to understand how different dimensions contribute to a particular outcome. It's especially useful when you want to perform root cause analysis or when you need to analyze data across multiple levels of granularity. It 1) provides an interactive and easy visual interface for data exploration. 2) helps in the aggregation of data and it’s easy to drill down. 3) Saves a lot of time by providing quick root cause analysis for finding patterns and trends in data. 4) lets you analyze data across multiple dimensions. All functionalities of this visual are available for free within Power BI Desktop. In Power BI Online Service, it will show a watermark. To use the visual without watermark in Power BI Online, please purchase license subscription For more information visit https://www.excelnaccess.com/decomposition-tree/ or contact zubair@excelnaccess.com Would love to get your feedback on this visual.
